### A Butcher’s Shop in the Middle of a Desert - One Year Devotions for Women
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/a-butcher-s-shop-in-the-middle-of-a-desert-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-22.html
Passage: Numbers 11:14
Points:
- Moses felt crushed by isolation, believing he was carrying the entire nation alone.
- The persistent and unreasonable complaints of the people turned his calling from a privilege into an unbearable burden.
- God addressed Moses' desperate prayer by offering a practical solution rather than a rebuke.
- Moses was instructed to share his leadership load with proven elders who were equipped with God's Spirit.
- Effective ministry relies on delegating responsibility so that both burdens and blessings are shared.

### Kill Me at Once!
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/kill-me-at-once
Passage: Numbers 11:15
Points:
- Moses was driven to exasperation and wished for death because of Israel's ungrateful rebellion over food.
- The Israelites overlooked God's miraculous presence and daily provision to complain about their temporary cravings.
- The narrative serves as a stark reminder of how emotionally and spiritually draining pastoral leadership can be.
- Christians are prone to grumble over minor inconveniences instead of resting in God's overwhelming grace.
- Believers are urged to encourage and bring joy to their leaders rather than causing them grief and burnout.
